name: flowdesk
description: FlowDesk — modern project & issue tracking for product teams

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@flowdesk/api && npm run build --workspace=@flowdesk/web
scripts.setup: node scripts/init-env.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait db && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:e2e
